document.abstract: From the history of the progress of the motion-picture industry and from the briefer and varying pattern of the television industry there emerges part of the basis for planning the education of future technicians. Recent scientific discoveries and new technological developments, current or potential, require educational emphasis on the physical sciences and on new techniques of recording pictures from motion.
